entry.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
entry.summary: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.

entry.title: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
entry.summary: Citi is the latest major financial institution to put the breaks on personal finance AI agents.

entry.title: Google’s AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
entry.summary: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.

entry.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
entry.summary: Lens creators can describe the Lens they want in plain language, and their AI assistant handles the process from start to finish, Snapchat says.

entry.title: Sam Altman says his life is so weird that he’s unfazed by Andrew Garfield portraying him in upcoming movie
entry.summary: "It doesn't feel like it's in like the top 10 weirdest things about my life," Altman said.

entry.title: Palmer Luckey thinks China is ‘thrilled to have Jensen out,’ so he wants the ousted Nvidia CEO reinstated
entry.summary: "It makes America weaker to knock him out," the Anduril CEO said about ousted Nvidia leader Jensen Huang.

entry.title: Palmer Luckey warns AI-powered cyberattacks are outpacing defenses: ‘It’s time to start running’
entry.summary: The Anduril co-founder says outdated technology is leaving systems vulnerable to a new wave of AI-enabled attacks.

entry.title: Nvidia created a weird bit of intrigue by not filing a routine SEC report
entry.summary: One Wall Street analyst got to the bottom of Nvidia's surprise announcement that it wouldn't be filing its formal quarterly results document, the 10-Q, for weeks.

entry.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
entry.summary: The long-awaited IPO reportedly values the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

entry.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
entry.summary: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.

entry.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
entry.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress, who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO.

entry.title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’
entry.summary: “I don’t think [Huang is] disloyal to the United States," Musk said.

entry.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
entry.summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.

entry.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
entry.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.

entry.title: Superhuman pushes its Go assistant everywhere
entry.summary: Superhuman is making Go its central agent and making it available in Docs and Mail.

entry.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
entry.summary: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.

entry.title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
entry.summary: In his Nasdaq opening bell speech, Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development, regardless of business or political pressure.

entry.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
entry.summary: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.

entry.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
entry.summary: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.

entry.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
entry.summary: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
